answer: Relic tokens are central to resisting Sybil attacks among AI agents. Each agent establishing its unique identity within a trust grove must lock a substantial amount of these scarce relic tokens as a provable stake. A raven-like validation service monitors these stakes, ensuring authenticity. An attacker attempting to create numerous fake identities incurs the immense financial burden of acquiring an equivalent supply of these high-value tokens, making the attack economically unsustainable and impractical.
